title: Wax ji am kiliftéef gu mat sëkk
intro: Bu njëkk, amoon na ku am doole juy jiite réew mu yaatu ak ñi ci dëkkoon. Nguuru nit ki dafa ànd ak mbégte bu rëy ak xeex bu xóot ci kiliftéefu Yàlla. Waajal gis ràññeekaay ruuh bu mujjee nekk njàngale buy yàgg ci jamono yépp.
clues: Maa ngi yor empire bu am doole, fu sama kàddu nekkoon yoon.
Ma wax ni man maay yàlla wi gëna mag, di sàkku ci ñépp ñi ma yor ñu jaamu ko.
Dama daan sonal benn askan, def leen ay jaam, ba noppi di santaane ñu ray seeni doom yu góor.
Dama daan faral di jàkkarloo ak ndawu Yàlla bu woyof, mu def kéemtaan yu leer ci sama kanam ak samay luxuskat.
Ma dëgër boppu bañ dëgg gi, jiiñ ndaw si ni dafay luxus, ba noppi di fexe ngir ray ko moom ak ñi ko topp.
Man ak sama larme yépp géej gi daal di laxasu, nu topp ñi ma génne ci samay loxo te baña xàddi.

outcome.answer: Yaram ñu ngi ko denc muy màndarga

arabic: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
verse: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them, (20:78)
